pages.text: The air intake is a kinetic block with a fan on its front and a $(item)shaft socket on its back$(). Turn that shaft and it fills its tank with air. Pipe the air out of any face; the tank holds $(item)8000 mB$() and only takes air.

$(l)Sizes$()$(li)Alone, as a $(item)1x1$().$(li)As a $(item)2x2$() or $(item)3x3$() square: all blocks side by side in one flat square, $(item)all facing the same way$(). The square turns into one big fan.

In a square, only $(item)one block needs to turn$(): the fastest block sets the speed of the whole fan. All of its air goes into one shared tank.$(br2)Using a wrench on the $(item)back face$() removes or restores the shaft socket, so you can choose which blocks of a square take the shaft.
The view shows a $(item)2x2$() intake facing south, ready to take a shaft from the north.
